record.question: Who is the winner of Australian Open Women's Single, 2019?
record.explanation: Answer C: Naomi Osaka. Naomi Osaka defeated Petra Kvitova 7–6(2), 5–7, 6–4 to win the 2019 Australian Open women’s singles title. The tournament’s own AO 2019 account records the result. Historical/source note: Women’s singles at the 2019 edition, not another year or doubles category. Reference: https://ausopen.com/articles/features/big-numbers-ao2019. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
